admissionPolicy.rule: A face is ADMITTED when printer or issuer authority establishes its exact product/face purpose, runtime UGO can prove mapping and orientation to the governed family, the applicable mechanical branch is governed, and an explicit Target Profile binding exists.
admissionPolicy.inheritanceRule: A proven family geometry, aim reference, procedure, mechanical branch, or confirmation fact is evaluated once and inherited by every traceably conforming face; publisher/product/face/representation identity never changes.
admissionPolicy.antiRedundancyRule: Printer Authority is Authority. Do not independently re-prove a printer's own product, face, purpose, configuration, dimensions, or printed-content statement. Publisher, SKU, color, logo, paper, branding, and non-operative wording differences never trigger re-governance of a family fact.
admissionPolicy.materialityRule: Govern what can change the executable result; record what cannot. Once an exact face is structurally reconciled to the governed 18 x 20 / center-aim family and no operative geometry difference is observed, raster scaling, paper carrier size, color, and non-operative wording remain representation metadata rather than a demand to re-prove family geometry.
admissionPolicy.registrationRule: Printer identity is preserved independently. A shared family UGO template may prove that a submitted photo maps to the governed geometry and orientation, but it never substitutes for or renames the printer's product representation. Registration and source reconciliation remain fail closed at runtime.
admissionPolicy.equipmentRule: Mechanical authority is inherited from the governed family only for an explicitly proven applicable equipment branch; unrelated marketing claims are ignored.
admissionPolicy.failureRule: Any unresolved required gate produces HOLD with exact missing facts. Candidate family assignment, visual similarity, or shared branding cannot create a runtime binding.

requiredGates.name: Physical geometry and pitch
requiredGates.proofRule: Prove conformance to the governed 18 x 20 / 0.96 cm physical family geometry by primary dimensions, traceable issued-form identity, or an exact-face structural reconciliation to an already-admitted family specimen that demonstrates the operative lattice and aim relationship while recording non-operative carrier/raster differences.

requiredGates.name: Aim reference
requiredGates.proofRule: Prove the center crosshairs/white-dot aim at 9 columns and 10 rows from the grid origin.

requiredGates.name: Exact representation and landmarks
requiredGates.proofRule: Preserve an exact face/side representation and enumerate asymmetric identity/orientation landmarks without substituting another publisher's artwork.

requiredGates.name: Standard M16A2/A3 procedure
requiredGates.proofRule: Prove the face is for the 25-meter M16A2/A3 to 300-meter procedure; the governed family supplies setup, finalization, and confirmation details once.

requiredGates.name: Applicable governed mechanical branch
requiredGates.proofRule: Prove M16A2 standard iron applicability, then bind the existing governed M16A2 mechanical authority. M16A4/M4 claims do not inherit this branch.

requiredGates.name: Exact-face registration and orientation
requiredGates.proofRule: Build and verify an exact-face Target Image Registration package with TOP/BOTTOM/LEFT/RIGHT proof and source-evidence reconciliation.

contracts.admissionRule: all six required gates PROVEN + explicit Target Profile binding + family-permitted mechanical authority

requiredGates.name: Physical geometry and pitch
requiredGates.proofRule: Accept the printer's M4 face identity and use runtime UGO to prove mapping to the governed 14 x 16 / 1.3 cm family geometry; do not independently re-measure printer facts.

requiredGates.name: Aim reference
requiredGates.proofRule: Prove the center crosshairs/white-dot aim at 7 columns and 8 rows from the grid origin.

requiredGates.name: Printer-authorized representation identity
requiredGates.proofRule: Preserve the printer-authorized product/face identity and provenance. The family UGO template is geometry/orientation machinery, never product identity substitution.

requiredGates.name: Standard M16A4/M4 25m/300m procedure
requiredGates.proofRule: Prove the 25-meter/300-meter family purpose, then select the governed equipment branch: M4/M4A1 uses 6/3 with no Z; M16A4 uses 6/3 plus two CLOCKWISE clicks to Z and returns two COUNTERCLOCKWISE clicks after confirmation.

requiredGates.name: Applicable governed mechanical branch
requiredGates.proofRule: Resolve the active equipment to either the governed M4/M4A1 DCH/FSP branch or the governed M16A4 standard-iron branch. Shared geometry never permits cross-application of mechanics.

requiredGates.name: Fail-closed family UGO registration and orientation
requiredGates.proofRule: Provide a Target Profile registration package that keeps printer identity distinct while proving source-photo mapping, TOP/BOTTOM/LEFT/RIGHT orientation, and source-evidence reconciliation against the governed family geometry.

contracts.admissionRule: printer-authorized M16A4/M4 face + runtime family UGO + explicit Target Profile binding + one exact governed equipment branch

requiredGates.name: Issuer-printed click-grid geometry
requiredGates.proofRule: Use the issuing face's 26 x 30 one-interval-per-click lattice without inventing an outer carrier dimension or MOA pitch.

requiredGates.name: Aim reference
requiredGates.proofRule: Prove the center white dot at 13 columns and 16 rows from the grid origin.

requiredGates.name: Exact issuer representation
requiredGates.proofRule: Preserve the NSN face and asymmetric issue, sight-control, and procedure landmarks.

requiredGates.name: M16A1 25m/250m procedure
requiredGates.proofRule: Use L aperture at 25m, move the group center to the white dot, then rotate to the unmarked aperture after confirmation.

requiredGates.name: M16A1 printed sight-control branch
requiredGates.proofRule: Bind only M16A1 iron sights and the issuer-printed one-grid-interval-per-click directions.

requiredGates.name: Exact-face registration and orientation
requiredGates.proofRule: Require the exact issuer-face UGO, TOP/BOTTOM/LEFT/RIGHT proof, and source reconciliation.

contracts.admissionRule: all six gates PROVEN + exact Army Target Profile binding + M16A1 family authority
